source_candidates.title: Menhan Sjafrie Terima Courtesy Call Athan Singapura, Apresiasi Dedikasi Selama Bertugas
provisional_claims: The Indonesian Ministry of Defense reports that Defense Minister Sjafrie Sjamsoeddin received outgoing Singapore defense attaché ME7 Gan Chee Weng Melvin at the ministry in Jakarta on October 5; the ministry published this account on October 6.

The ministry characterized the courtesy call as defense diplomacy and appreciation for the attaché's work supporting Indonesia–Singapore defense communications; its account also reports meetings with the deputy minister and secretary-general.
caveats: The October 6 publication recounts October 5 meetings; do not report the meeting as taking place on October 6.
The account is Indonesia's ministry's characterization, not a joint statement or independent confirmation from Singapore.
A courtesy call does not by itself establish a new agreement, exercise, procurement commitment, operational coordination or concrete policy change.
Do not infer a causal or operational connection to Japan's October 6 Kunisaki departure or Philippine emergency-response exercises.
Full original Indonesian text and captured response need independent human source-to-claim and translation checks before publication.
